rules.justification: Solid mechanics model (docs/NUMERICAL_VALIDATION.md, 'Solid mechanics model'): every case of fixtures/model/smm is produced with the Eigen sparse solver, whose MPL-2.0 translation is bit-identical; every model quantity is either an input fed unchanged to the port (mesh, material file, affine field and initial velocity computed with sequential sums) or the output of computations whose operation order the port replicates statement by statement (FE kernels with Eigen product routes, DOF-manager assembly orders, material laws, integration schemes, Newton-Raphson norms, energy sums in upstream accumulation order). Bit identity is the expected result; any difference is a defect.
rules.evidence: crates/akantu-solid/tests/model_smm_fixtures.rs observes every compared value bit-identical (per-step SHA-256 digests of u || v || a for the 100-step patch runs). An independent review accepted the rule for the 105 cases (6 regenerated byte-identical, 2 adversarial cases bitwise); 2026-11-11: added 17 cases (review_*, patch_static_anisotropic_*, eigenstrain_stiffness_tetrahedron_4, loaded_static_*), all bit-identical.
rules.reviewed_by: independent review during the port, November 2026
